title: 산업융합 촉진법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Support for Activities of Integrated Industry Linkage Organizations) As defined in Article 21(2) of the "Act on Promotion of Integrated Industries" (hereinafter referred to as "the Act"), the activities "relating to the investigation, analysis, etc., as specified in the Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy's ordinance concerning the promotion of new integrated industries" refer to the following activities: <amended March 23, 2013, October 1, 2025>
1. Investigation and research for the identification of new integrated industries
2. Collection and exchange of information necessary for the development of new integrated industry products and the market research and analysis of integrated industries
3. Establishment and support of a database for basic information required for new integrated industries
4. Any other activities necessary to promote the development of new integrated industries
